description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Asks the email provider to check the domain's DNS records now and returns the status (pending while DNS propagates, verified when ready).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity/domain/verify.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_domain_verify
title: Check a brand's sending domain
